title: Battle of Plassey
subtitle: The battle that opened the door to Company control in Bengal.
summary: The Battle of Plassey in 1757 marked a decisive shift in Bengal's political destiny. A short military encounter turned into a structural transfer of power as the East India Company used alliance, betrayal, and financial leverage to secure influence in Bengal. The aftermath reshaped governance, revenue extraction, and sovereignty, laying the foundation for long-term colonial rule.
heroTagline: Plassey was less a battlefield victory alone and more a political capture of Bengal's state power.
whyItMatters: Plassey matters because it helps explain how colonial domination in Bengal began through intertwined military action, elite realignment, and economic control.
